description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to obtain a list of regions supported by WUYING Workspace.

description.zh: 用户个人盘的存储峰值。该值不可大于企业网盘中可分配的剩余容量。单位：Byte（字节）。
description.en: Maximum storage size for a user's personal cloud drive. This value must not exceed the remaining available capacity in the enterprise cloud drive. Unit: byte.
